description: Otharia wears an opaque cream and muted purple floor-length court dress with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Purple panels frame the cream central bodice and skirt, with narrow gold woven borders along the neckline, cuffs, waist, skirt sides and hem. Small round brooches sit at neckline corners. A purple wrap with gold borders and fringed ends rests around her forearms and drapes down both sides. A narrow decorated girdle with an oval clasp and hanging tassels secures the waist. A modest bracelet and small earrings add subtle jewelry. Brown embroidered flat shoes peek below the hem. Her short bob is uncovered.
